title: How do I delete a survey?
intent: This article explains how to delete a survey from EUSurvey.
short_answer: To delete a survey, select it from your Forms list and click Delete. Only unpublished surveys can be deleted directly. Published surveys must first be unpublished. Deleted surveys are soft-deleted and can be restored by administrators. After a grace period, they are permanently removed.
prerequisites: The user must be the survey owner
The survey must be unpublished to delete from the Forms page
procedure: Confirm the deletion in the dialog.
The survey is marked as deleted (soft delete).
important_conditions: Only unpublished surveys can be deleted by the owner from the Forms list.
Published surveys must be unpublished first.
Deletion is initially a soft-delete; the survey can be restored by an administrator.
Permanently deleted surveys cannot be recovered.
Running surveys (with active contributions) should not be deleted.
Administrators can permanently delete from the admin survey search.
troubleshooting: 'Cannot delete running survey': Unpublish the survey first.
Survey not appearing after deletion: It has been soft-deleted. Contact admin to restore.
